itemsSent.title: European Natural Gas Prices Rise on Middle East Escalation
Inside the 2026 Tanker War: Hormuz Strikes, Soaring Rates & Diesel Shortages
itemsSent.why: Hormuz tanker strikes drive Brent crude up on supply risks, while regional refinery disruptions tighten middle distillates, lifting diesel prices.

itemsSent.title: Tight product supplies lift US summer refinery utilization to highest level since 1998
itemsSent.why: High utilization is bullish products due to tight supply, but lower overall capacity caps crude demand, making crude slightly bearish relative to products.

itemsSent.title: ARA gasoline stocks drop to lowest level since September 2021
itemsSent.why: ARA gasoline inventories fell to their lowest since September 2021 due to strong export demand, providing a bullish catalyst for gasoline prices.

itemsSent.title: European gas at 2022 peaks as Houthi Strikes trigger U.S. evacuation order
itemsSent.why: European gas hits 2022 highs and geopolitical panic spreads after Houthi strikes prompt US evacuations in Saudi Arabia.

itemsSent.title: Hapag-Lloyd expects more shipping services to return to Suez Canal
itemsSent.why: Expected return of shipping services to Suez Canal reduces transit times, lowering tanker demand and shipping costs, which weighs on crude prices.

itemsSent.title: Rising Crude Oil Imports Reduce China’s Need to Draw from Stocks
itemsSent.why: China reducing its need to draw from strategic inventories by increasing crude imports signals plateauing domestic release, keeping global prices in check.

itemsSent.title: Iran war live: European, Mideast ministers meet in Istanbul for talks
itemsSent.why: Diplomatic talks on the Strait of Hormuz could ease supply fears, weighing slightly on crude while leaving refined products mixed.

itemsSent.title: Japan Weighs Gasoline Subsidy Cuts as Energy Costs Soar
itemsSent.why: Subsidy cuts in Japan could lower retail demand for gasoline, exerting downward pressure on refined product prices.

itemsSent.title: Splash Wrap: Sanctions, spreadsheets and shipyards
itemsSent.why: Authorizing sales of sanctioned tankers to lower soaring freight costs and bring capacity back increases crude supply availability, putting downward pressure on prices.

itemsSent.title: Russia shipping first diesel cargo to US this week after sanctions waiver
itemsSent.why: Russian diesel heading to the US via sanctions waiver increases US supply (bearish HO) while rerouting trade flows globally.
